description: This Java interface defines a builder pattern for creating responses and events related to the 'DeleteThing' command within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes nested factory interfaces for producing command responses (success and error cases) and events (like 'ThingDeleted') that are triggered as part of processing the delete command.

classes.name: DeleteThingLiveCommandAnswerBuilder
classes.description: Interface that defines a builder for creating responses and events for the 'DeleteThing' command, extending the modify command response step.

classes.name: DeleteThingLiveCommandAnswerBuilder.ResponseFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating command responses related to deletion of a Thing, including success and error responses.

classes.name: DeleteThingLiveCommandAnswerBuilder.EventFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating events when a 'DeleteThing' command is processed, such as the 'ThingDeleted' event.

methods.name: deleted
methods.description: Creates a success response indicating the Thing was deleted.

methods.name: thingNotAccessibleError
methods.description: Creates an error response indicating the Thing could not be accessed.

methods.name: thingNotDeletableError
methods.description: Creates an error response indicating the Thing could not be deleted.

methods.name: deleted
methods.description: Creates a 'ThingDeleted' event indicating the Thing has been deleted.
